text:
jun park: Quick sync  — exploring a compact breadcrumb with a collapsed middle and accessible expand. Prototype: https://sketch.redwood/compact-crumbs (WIP). Main goals: keep legacy links working, preserve ?query and #hash, avoid focus traps on deep links.

elaine wu: Nice. UX nits: collapsed crumb needs a clear label for SRs, e.g. button aria-label="Expand path". Tooltip should say "Expand full path" not the full raw URL.

mike cole: Router plan: middleware maps old paths to new canonical ones. Server redirects get 301 for external hits; client-side visits use history.replaceState so no extra history entries. We'll preserve search/hash. Example pseudo: 
```
if (legacy(path)) {
  target = map[path]
  res.redirect(301, `${target}${req.url.search}${req.url.hash}`)
}
```

priya rao: Docs ask: add a small migration blurb and public redirect table. Also telemetry on deeplink_opened with origin (docs|ticket|other). We'll coordinate after infra ticket.

samir (sam): Accessibility checklist: 1) ellipsis/expand button has aria-expanded + aria-controls 2) opening moves focus to the first item in the expanded list 3) breadcrumb updates announced via aria-live="polite" 4) if deep link targets a panel, do not auto-open large panels; show a compact header with an explicit Open button. I'll own tests.

zoe kim: tiny visual: when collapsed, show a short path preview like "org / ... / model-name" so people know context. Also animate expand with reduced motion support.

jun park: good call Zoe. Quick decision on group label for the left nav: should we use "Serving and endpoints" (sentence case) or something shorter? Elaine?

elaine wu: prefer sentence case "Serving and endpoints". Also collapse tooltip for full sidebar should be "Hide navigation" (when hiding entire sidebar) — keep wording consistent.

mike cole: I'll file infra ticket PLAT-4207 for redirect table + router shim + telemetry + X-Original-Path header. Will include replaceState behavior and keep-hash requirement.

priya rao: I'll prep the docs blurb: "Breadcrumbs now collapse long paths; legacy links continue to resolve." Short and friendly. Please ping me when PLAT-4207 is live.

samir (sam): add acceptance criteria to the PR: legacy permalinks resolve (preserve query/hash), expand button aria attributes, breadcrumb live region, focus management for deep links.

jun park: Final checklist: prototype update (jun), infra ticket (mike), a11y tests (sam), docs blurb (priya), microcopy tweaks (elaine). I'll post updated frames tomorrow. :thumbsup:
